bd-f5tt CLOSED (by flywheel-toron-oc, 36616f2) + CalmPeak follow-up.

Found the close was incomplete: 36616f2 was REVERTED by project-message commit 53782cc (HEAD lost all guard code), and live E2E exposed 2 correctness bugs in the original wiring:
1. CRITICAL slug-alias: reservations tagged with slug as-written (CLI=absolute path /Users/.../toron, MCP=short "toron"). Guard queried verbatim → cross-surface reservations NEVER matched → the silent-overwrite path survived the hook. Fixed: project_slug_aliases + active_reservations_all_aliases (all basename-colliding data-dir roots, both spellings, dedup).
2. alt_agent_key shadow: project root with agents/ blocked descent → nested path-slug roots invisible to basename fallback. Walk now descends.
3. flywheel repo hook baked --project toron (wrong project) → re-baked to flywheel.

Restored as 6b07435 (7 files, 381+25 tests, 2 new f5tt regression tests). Live gate through the REAL pre-commit hook in a temp repo: foreign commit on exclusively-reserved file rc=1 (blocked, staging intact), holder rc=0, independent file rc=0, unattributed fails open rc=0. Installed ~/.cargo/bin/toron re-signed (macOS amfid SIGKILLed the overwritten ad-hoc sig — codesign --force --sign -).
